svg.title: The Lions contour profile
svg.desc: Illustrative contour lines following The Lions’ twin-summit profile. Transparent artwork for a full-width footer alpha mask.
svg.metadata: Profile interpreted from The Lions, Vancouver, British Columbia, 1922, Coast Publishing Company / British Library, HS85/10/40365. Public-domain photographic reference: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Lions,_Vancouver,_British_Columbia_(HS85-10-40365).jpg . Contour bands are illustrative, not measured elevation data.
